summary: Phase F verified end-to-end. Backend POST /api/ai/app-help (public, GPT-4o via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY): 7/7 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/backend_iteration23_test.py — endpoint returns 200 with app-specific answers referencing Reports/Bank Reconcile/CSV for reconcile questions, Templates/Shifts/plan for pre-filled invoice questions, and compliance-panel fields (participant, issue date, due date, line item, address) for 'why won't my invoice send?'. Empty messages → 400. No i18n key leaks (help.q*, dashboard.*) in AI answers. Endpoint is confirmed public (no auth header). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as TEST_USER_EMAIL): (1) tips-banner renders below hero with a category label (e.g. 'TAX & ABN', 'MEDICATION') and a real tip sentence — NOT an i18n key. Tapping it advances to a different tip (verified text changed from 'You must register for GST once...' → 'If a medication error occurs...'). Rotation timer + fade animation working. (2) tool-help tile visible in Dashboard tools grid; tapping it navigates to help-screen. (3) help-screen shows intro message and 'Popular questions' with all 6 chips quick-help.q1 … quick-help.q6 rendered with real English text (no key leaks). (4) Tapping quick-help.q1 ('How do I set up pre-filled invoices?') showed 'Looking it up…' then returned an app-specific answer referencing Templates/Shifts/plan shift. (5) Free-form 'why won't my invoice send?' via help-input + help-send returned an answer explicitly listing the 6 compliance fields (participant/client name, NDIS number, billing address OR email, issue date, due date, line item). Matches spec exactly. (6) help-mic renders and toggles without crash (permission prompt handled gracefully; no red screen). Console shows only pre-existing RN-Web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications web token) already reported in iter 22 — no new warnings. Deprecated-package audit: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch in package.json. Tips banner is intentionally English-only (i18n deferred per PRD).

react_native_issues.component: RN-Web deprecation warnings (pre-existing, carry-over from iter 18-22)
react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents deprecation warnings still logged. Cosmetic only; migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents when convenient. Not introduced this iteration.

TipsBanner uses useNativeDriver:true for opacity fade; RN-Web logs 'useNativeDriver is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation'. Web-only warning — animation still works. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TipsBanner.tsx:23,26. Optional: set useNativeDriver:false OR leave as-is since native builds benefit from true.

phase_f_verification.sample_answer_free_form: If your invoice won't send, check these key compliance items on the invoice screen: 1. Participant/client name. 2. NDIS participant number. 3. A billing address OR email. 4. An issue date. 5. A due date. 6. At least one line item with both a description and a rate.

action_items: No blocking issues found. Phase F ships as-is.
OPTIONAL (carry-over, cosmetic): migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents across the app to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: TipsBanner uses useNativeDriver:true — on web this falls back to JS animation with a warning. Either set useNativeDriver:false or ignore (native benefits from true).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:556 /api/ai/app-help is correctly public (mirrors /api/ai/ndis-assistant) — no auth dependency, uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + GPT-4o via emergentintegrations LlmChat. System prompt is grounded on APP_HELP_KNOWLEDGE and includes correct guardrails ('never invent features that aren't in the guide', 'do not give financial/legal/clinical advice').
server.py:562 history = req.messages[-8:] correctly caps context window to last 8 messages — cheap on tokens.
server.py:585 error is properly logged with logger.exception; frontend falls back to t('help.error') on any api.appHelp failure (help.tsx:38).
TipsBanner.tsx: shuffle uses a local useMemo so per-user session shows a stable random order — good UX. Timer cleanup on unmount is correct.
tips.ts has 52 entries covering all 9 categories (invoicing, payments, ndis, compliance, medication, safety, tax, wellbeing, app) with TIP_STYLE labels — matches PRD.
help.tsx: QUICK array iterates i18n keys 'help.q1'..'help.q6' and testIDs are `quick-${k}` = 'quick-help.q1' etc — testable, matches spec exactly.
help.tsx:23 initial assistant intro message correctly uses t('help.intro') — no key leak observed at runtime.
help.tsx:30-44 send() correctly appends user msg optimistically, calls api.appHelp with full conversation, and handles error via t('help.error'). Auto-scroll on send + reply is implemented.
help.tsx is 145 lines, TipsBanner.tsx is 77 lines — well under 700-line split threshold.
